entities.name: Chic Hecht
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mayer Jacob Hecht was an American Republican politician and diplomat who served as a United States senator from Nevada from 1983 to 1989, and as U.S. ambassador to the Bahamas from 1989 to 1993.
